newsitem.title: USA: Motorola launches cable modem in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Motorola launches cable modem in Mexico.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Multimedia Group said Thursday it is supplying CyberSURFR cable modems to Television Internacional S.A. de C.V.'s InterCable unit in Monterrey, Mexico.
Motorola and InterCable are launching commercial Internet service on Thursday in Monterrey, Mexico.
The InterCable launch is Motorola's first commercial cable modem deployment in Mexico. Motorola said it will ship 3,000 CyberSURFR cable modems to InterCable by the end of the year.
The cable modem allow subscribers to access the Internet at high speeds via cable TV lines.
